## Micro-report

### Introduction

### Loading the data & initializing the libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
```

We are going to be working with the diabetes data set. The objective of this micro-report is finding out which out of all the possible variables determine the possibility of diabetes.

```{r}
diabetes <- read_csv("data/diabetes.csv")
```

### Re-structuring the data

```{r}
diabetes <- diabetes |>
  select('chol', 'stab.glu', 'hdl', 'ratio', 'glyhb') |>
  mutate(diagnosis = case_when(
    glyhb >= 7 ~ "diabetic",
    glyhb < 7 ~ "not_diabetic"
  ))
```

### Analysis

```{r}
pca_fit <- diabetes %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)

```

```{r}
pca_fit %>%
  augment(diabetes) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(.fittedPC1, .fittedPC2, color = diagnosis)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(diabetic = "#D55E00", not_diabetic = "#0072B2")
  ) +
  theme_half_open(12) + background_grid()
```
